Question: Four circles, no two of which are congruent, have centers at \(A,\) \(B,\) \(C,\) and \(D,\) and points \(P\) and \(Q\) lie on all four circles. The radius of circle \(A\) is \(\dfrac58\) times the radius of circle \(B,\) and the radius of circle \(C\) is \(\dfrac58\) times the radius of circle \(D.\) Furthermore, \(AB = CD = 39\) and \(PQ = 48.\) Let \(R\) be the midpoint of \(\overline{PQ}.\) What is \(AR + BR + CR + DR?\)
